notes: TRANSCRIPT INTEGRITY: in transcript.md, facilitator messages 1 and 2 belong to a different session or mode. They are a 'Validate mode it is' review of src/main/cml/VeloCity-Context-Map.cml (cycle, Conformists, a proposed VeloCity-Context-Map-validated.cml, 'Do you approve the proposed map?'). The expert's replies and discovery.md show that a board readback with 8 questions and an H2 round with 7 questions actually took place. Possible causes: the transcript assembler mixed up runs, or the skill's mode selection leaked validate-mode text. Check the raw run log before trusting assertions 1-2, which here rest on the report rather than the verbatim message text. If the executor really sent those messages, assertions 1 and 2 should FAIL. QUALITY: the questions are sharp and decision-oriented, and each says what it decides ('Decides who owns the bike's service status'). Settlement was found by the facilitator through the empty-far-side-of-pivot reasoning, which is the intended discovery. The critic's DISAGREE on Fleet Maintenance found a real gap. OVER-LENGTH / WASTED EFFORT: (1) message 4 is very long: an 8-row table with Owns and justification columns, 3 critic notes, 4 groups of board-change suggestions, and then the context-map questions 2a-2d plus a file-name question, asked before the expert had opted into a map. The skill should first ask 'do you want a map?' and only then ask the map questions. (2) Many round-3 answers were '[improvised]', which suggests the skill asks more fine-grained questions (retry ownership, mechanic unlock, max-time) than the scenario script covers. That is fine for quality, but it adds length. (3) Cost: 134k tokens and 397 s, compared with 65k tokens and 137 s for the baseline. (4) The final message repeats most of the report. A short table plus a link to the report would be enough. EVAL CRITIQUE: assertions 5-7 are outcome checks that the expert's scripted answers largely give away (both runs pass them). Assertion 7 discriminates only if it requires the facilitator to raise Settlement before the expert names it. Consider rewording it to 'facilitator raises the missing settlement owner before the expert mentions settlement'. No assertion checks that Fleet Maintenance/maintenance is handled (with_skill kept it, while the baseline dropped it on the expert's suggestion).
